en.headline: Police arrest 11 in Strongjab operation against money-laundering syndicate
en.dek: Officers detained eight men and three women aged 19 to 43 over a network that processed about HK$70 million linked to 85 scam cases.
body: Police arrested 11 people in a two-day operation codenamed Strongjab targeting a local money-laundering syndicate, officers said on Wednesday.

The group allegedly used offers of no-assessment loans to lure people into selling or opening bank accounts and registering phone cards. Those accounts were then used to launder proceeds from 85 scam cases involving losses of more than HK$24 million. The syndicate is believed to have handled about HK$70 million in suspected criminal proceeds.

Eight men and three women aged 19 to 43 were detained on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud, money laundering and criminal intimidation. Some were released on bail while others remained in custody. Police searched 13 locations, including two company premises, and seized phones, SIM cards, bank documents and a notebook listing account sellers. Officers urged the public not to rent, lend or sell personal accounts or identity documents.

zh.headline: 警方「猛刺」行動拘11人 破洗黑錢集團涉85宗騙案
zh.dek: 警方拘捕8男3女，年齡介乎19至43歲，集團涉嫌處理約7000萬元犯罪得益，牽涉85宗騙案損失逾2400萬元。
body: 警方周三表示，一連兩日展開代號「猛刺」的行動，搗破一個本地洗黑錢集團，拘捕11人。
集團涉嫌以「免審查貸款」為餌，誘使市民出售或開立銀行戶口及實名登記電話卡。有關傀儡戶口用以清洗85宗騙案的犯罪得益，騙款超過2400萬港元。集團據信已處理約7000萬港元懷疑犯罪得益。
被捕的8名男子及3名女子年齡介乎19至43歲，涉嫌串謀詐騙、洗黑錢及刑事恐嚇。部分人已獲准保釋，其餘正被扣查。警方搜查全港13個地點，包括兩間涉案公司，檢獲電話、電話卡、銀行文件及一本記錄賣戶口人士資料的數簿。警方呼籲市民切勿租、借或賣個人戶口及身份證明文件。
